 Quick Details

 Located inbetween Egg Harbor and Fish Creek:
 Located just 3 miles from the peninsula state park entrance.

 Contactless self checkout:
 Please note:
- E-bike breakage insurance policy offered; it costs $10 a bike and it covers any sort of bike breakage. If you choose to not buy ebike rental insurance; if the bike is damaged then you can be billed up to $1250 based on the assessment of damages done to the bike.

- Wearing a helmet while e-biking is mandatory

- Note that this is a SELF RENTAL! Meaning to please read the sandwich boards when you arrive, that will have all the information that you'll need about your rental including a video to watch, the waiver and different ebike routes. If you need more information you can give our shop a call at 920-868-1400

- Note that the port-a-potty at the house is for your use and availability, but that you are not to enter the main house or garage! 

Things to Bring

Summer: Closed-toe shoes, (optional)a baseball cap to put under the helmet(required)

Fall: Prepare to have a few layers and gloves and a hat to put on or take off to keep comfortable. Don't forget your sense of adventure!

Things to Do before Rental

Please watch this brief video before enjoying your e-bike experience :[e--bike safety video](https://youtu.be/7NC_w8z2z1M)

 What is an E-Bike?

An E-Bike is  an electronic bicycle that has a pedal assist feature. E-Bikes pedal assist means less physical effort is required so you can spend your time enjoying the views, not catching your breath.

Adjust the bike’s electric assistance to fit your preferences. It’s suitable both for people who want a good workout and for those that don’t want to expend much energy.

Easier than a Segway and a whole lot cooler!
